This FloPlast uPVC soil pipe is designed for effective waste water drainage within soil and vent systems, a fundamental component for connecting sanitary ware to the main network. Ideal for new build installations, extensions, or renovation projects in various properties, this 110mm diameter grey soil pipe provides a standard plumbing solution. Its robust uPVC construction ensures durability for long-lasting performance. The push-fit connection with ring seal joints allows for quick and secure installation, saving valuable time on site. The single socket design offers straightforward integration into existing or new soil systems.
